name: Stories
what: Phone stories: pictures (yours, or soft colour fills) play one after another full screen with the progress bars filling at the top, the name in the corner, a quick zoom on each cut and a slow push-in, a tilted caption sticker popping on each.

learned_from.what: stories playing with bars filling at the top and a caption on each

motion: each story 60 f: cut in 1.12 -> 1.04 in 8 f, then a slow push-in; its bar fills linearly; the caption back.out 10 f in, tilted
